name: New Hampshire

jury_list.statute: RSA 500-A:1, IV: 'Information contained in the master jury list shall be private and confidential and shall not be subject to RSA 91-A.' RSA 500-A:2: voter lists, Department of Safety lists, and the master jury list 'are confidential documents to be used ... only for purposes of jury selection.'
jury_list.holder: Administrative Office of the Courts and clerks of the superior court.

voter_file.who_may_get: Any person may get a copy of the public checklist of a town or city from the supervisors of the checklist or the town or city clerk, for a fee (RSA 654:31, II). The full statewide list goes only to parties, political committees, and candidates (654:31, IV). Anyone may view statewide data at the state archives but may not print, duplicate, or transmit it (654:31, III).
voter_file.permitted_uses: No commercial purposes (sale of property or services unrelated to an election or campaign) (654:31, I(b), VI).
voter_file.penalty: Misdemeanor for a natural person, felony for any other person (654:31, VI).

private_challenge.who: At the polls only: a challenge to 'the person seeking to vote' must be a signed affidavit under oath administered by an election official (RSA 659:27-a). Non-citizenship is a listed ground. No pre-election written challenge by a private voter was found.

sources.cite: RSA 654:44 (supervisors may remove a name only after 30 days' mailed notice and a meeting)

county_board.name: New Hampshire Secretary of State - Register to Vote (contact your town or city clerk)
county_board.note: New Hampshire runs elections by town and city. Supervisors of the checklist decide removals (RSA 654:44).

state_election_office.name: New Hampshire Secretary of State - Elections

ag.name: New Hampshire Department of Justice (Attorney General)

gates.basis: Jury list data is confidential by law (RSA 500-A:1, IV and 500-A:2). Challenges exist only at the polls (RSA 659:27-a). Strict gates: counts only.

notes: RSA 500-A:2 (as amended 2025) says errors the court finds in voter-list data are reported to the Secretary of State. The text does not say this covers non-citizen juror answers, so official_pipeline stays null.
The sos.nh.gov and doj.nh.gov sites refuse plain HTTP clients; the referral pages were checked in a browser.
dob_in_public_file and registration_date_in_public_file are null: RSA 654:25 (public checklist contents) was not read in this batch.
